title: Chewy Herbal Uruguayan Pistachio Empanadas
description: A quick-fix Uruguayan snack featuring unsalted pistachios, a touch of herbal spices, and a crunchy pastry crust. Perfect for a light meal or snack.
instructions: Preheat your oven to 375°F (190°C). Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt-free seasoning blend, and cinnamon powder.
Add the cubed butter to the flour mixture and use a pastry blender or your fingertips to work it into a crumbly mixture.
Gradually add the beaten egg to the mixture, stirring with a fork until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for about 5 minutes, until smooth and elastic.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces. Roll each piece into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk.
In the center of each dough disk, mix together the chopped pistachios, bhuna spices, granulated sugar, rose water, and vinegar.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape, pressing the edges to seal. Use a fork to crimp the edges.
Place the empanadas on the prepared baking sheet and brush the tops with a little water.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow the empanadas to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring them to a wire rack to cool completely.
